judgement.impact: The screen-reader user hears only 'image' and cannot know about the 50% OFF TODAY promotion visible to sighted users.
User hears 'Total:' with no amount and cannot confirm the total charge before paying.
The user cannot know the card number is flagged as invalid and may try to pay without correcting it.
The user hears only Submit and cannot confirm the button will pay R1,249 at the moment of payment.
The user hears Close instead of delete/clear and cannot know the button removes payment data, risking an unintended destructive action.
User hears only generic Button and cannot identify or confidently use the Pay with wallet option.
The screen-reader user hears only generic "Click here" and cannot know the link leads to the Terms they agree to when paying.
